Salamander Grand Piano samples — Alexander Holm.
Source: https://github.com/Tonejs/audio/tree/master/salamander
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Local derivatives: nine reference notes converted to mono 32 kHz MP3 at 64 kbps,
trimmed to eight seconds with a 0.3 second fade at the end.
The app transposes the nearest reference sample and applies a release envelope.
Original author notes and license: SOURCE-LICENSE.txt.
